header: Anything from Upper Austria and Salzburg reaches Ines first
lead: She spent eight years in a pastry shop before she came to us, which shows in the questions she asks before she answers any.
author: Ines Straubinger
quote_text: Tell me first how many people are behind the counter on a Saturday. After that we can talk about software.
note: Monday to Thursday all day, Friday until 1pm. Out of those hours the general service number takes over.
